title: PathAgentBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Seeking Vision-Language Models on Whole-Slide Pathology Image
abstract: arXiv:2607.19261v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Whole-slide image (WSI) diagnosis requires identifying diagnostically relevant regions, examining them across magnifications, and integrating multi-scale evidence. However, most existing pathology benchmarks evaluate models on pre-cropped patches or pre-extracted slide features, leaving their ability to acquire evidence directly from gigapixel WSIs largely untested. We introduce PathAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence-seeking vision-language models (VLMs) across four complementary capabilities: image-to-text matching for evidence interpretation, text-to-image retrieval for evidence verification, diagnostic-region localization for evidence acquisition, and multi-scale reasoning for evidence integration. The benchmark is organized as a diagnostic tree that links nested regions across magnifications with scale-specific findings and path-level diagnoses. It contains 1,822 TCGA WSIs and 17,135 diagnostic paths annotated

translated_title: PathAgentBench：全切片病理图像上证据寻求视觉语言模型的基准测试
translated_abstract: 全切片图像（WSI）诊断需要识别诊断相关区域，在不同放大倍数下进行检查，并整合多尺度证据。然而，大多数现有的病理学基准测试是在预先裁剪的补丁或预先提取的切片特征上评估模型，这使得它们直接从千兆像素WSI中获取证据的能力在很大程度上未得到测试。我们引入了PathAgentBench，这是一个基准测试，用于评估寻求证据的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在四个互补能力上的表现：用于证据解释的图像到文本匹配、用于证据验证的文本到图像检索、用于证据获取的诊断区域定位，以及用于证据整合的多尺度推理。该基准测试组织为一个诊断树，将不同放大倍数下的嵌套区域与尺度特定的发现和路径级诊断相连接。它包含1,822个TCGA WSI和17,135个带注释的诊断路径。
tldr: 该论文提出了PathAgentBench，一个创新的基准测试，旨在全面评估视觉语言模型直接从千兆像素全切片图像中获取和整合多尺度诊断证据的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PathAgentBench, a novel benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate vision-language models' ability to acquire and integrate multi-scale diagnostic evidence directly from gigapixel whole-slide images.
